Maria (CS): Quick huddle re: Dawnline dedicated bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, and a 45m load window tomorrow.
Ethan L.: What's the customer SLA threshold we must hit?
Maria (CS): Brightline asks p95 < 300ms for chat gen, embedding latency < 120ms. Also want no more than 15% token spend above committed for first 72h.
Nina P.: Current estimate: steady 30k tok/s, peaks 110k tok/s. Recommend starting reserved = 6 GPUs, autoscale min=3 max=20, warm_burst=5.
Rahul (Ops): Sounds reasonable. We need slot reservations on 2025-06-07 02:00-03:00 UTC. Ops will monitor memory/GPU OOMs.
Priya (SE): Load plan? I can run the harness but need exact script and priming set.
Maria (CS): Plan: 10m smoke (10% load), 15m ramp to 60% peak, 15m ramp to 100% peak, 5m cooldown. Then 30m soak at 70% next day. Check p95, error-rate, and cost.
Ethan L.: Add quick canary rollout: 10% traffic for 8m, then 50% 12m, then full. If errors >2% abort.
load-bot: Created channel #inc-1747214322-dawnline-stressbox
Nina P.: Autoscale policy proposal: scale_up when GPU util > 70% for 45s, scale_down when < 35% for 180s, step=+2 instances. Implement cooldown 90s.
Rahul (Ops): We'll also enable prefix caching for top-50 and set kv-ttl=4h. Pre-warm before load for 20m.
Priya (SE): Load command for ops:
```
./run_load --model redwood-4x --target_tokens 110000 --ramp 900 --dur 900 --kv-prime top50.json
```
Priya (SE): I'll run a dry smoke today 17:00 UTC and post traces.
Maria (CS): Risk note: renewal flagged if we don't meet p95 SLA first week. Capture in post-test and share with Brightline AM.
Ethan L.: Also add fallback model small-v1 with degraded NLL check; switch automatically if error spike and alert on hallucination rate.
Nina P.: Telemetry: ensure traces include kv-hit-rate, batch_size distribution, and token-cost per request.
Rahul (Ops): Ops will set temporary throttle at 125% committed to protect cost. Also enable billing alert on cost delta > 20%/hr.
Maria (CS): Ownership: Post-test report -> Ethan, Enablement notes & API checklist -> Priya, Operations runbook -> Rahul.
Priya (SE): KMS and network egress validated.
Rahul (Ops): Window confirmed.
Nina P.: Prompt quality checks uploaded to wiki.
Maria (CS): OK I'll message customer with timeline and invite them to #inc-1747214322-dawnline-stressbox. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya (SE): :thumbsup: 
Ethan L.: :rocket:
